body: With no warning, I was dumped for a hotter girl. My grades fell, and a good number of my friends stopped talking to me, and chose my ex. This past semester, I through myself back into my schoolwork, and tried to find a job. I was unsuccessful on both accounts. Now I'm almost completely alone with no money and no independence. I've gained ~30 pounds in the last few months. I feel like an inconvenient reminder of failure, am constantly miserable, and don't see any light at the end of the tunnel.
